sentences.text: Jacket2 (J2) is an online magazine of commentary on modern and contemporary poetry and poetics, which publishes articles, reviews, interviews, discussions and collaborative responses, archival documents, podcasts, and descriptions of poetry symposia and projects.

It publishes content as it is ready, in its own phrase "Not unlike a daily news forum", and keeps an index of everything it has published; the encyclopedia's account says new material is added every day, and nothing in its saved pages calls it peer-reviewed.
Its unit is the piece, filed under the sections Articles, Features, Reviews, Interviews, Commentaries, Reissues, Podcasts, Poems and Galleries, each piece under the names of its author or authors.

Whether it publishes poetry is stated two ways: Wikipedia, "As of 2023", says it "does not publish poetry", while its own index lists a Poems section and its home page carries "a new poem by Michele Leggott".
The encyclopedia also reads it, under its own hedge, as a magazine that "primarily featured original content but also included material that was excerpted from or co-produced with other sources".

It is hosted by the Kelly Writers House at 3805 Locust Walk, Philadelphia, a programming and community space on the campus of the University of Pennsylvania that counts Jacket2 among the publications it sponsors or hosts.

The Writers House was founded in 1995 by Al Filreis with volunteers from the university's faculty, students, staff and alumni, is partially funded by the university's Provost's Office, and is the subject of a Jacket2 commentary by Filreis on its founding thirty years on.
Filreis, Kelly Family Professor of English and the Writers House's founder and faculty director, is the publisher of Jacket2 and keeps an ongoing commentary there.
Wikipedia names Jessica Lowenthal, director of the Writers House, as associate publisher, and Julia Bloch and Michael S. Hennessey as editors.

The home page signs a memorial to Alice Notley "Jacket2 Editors" and names an editorial assistant, Emi Wong Shing; its About page returned "The requested page could not be found." when the census saved it.

The census accordingly records its operator as Jacket2 at the Writers House address, with no editorial board named beyond the collective signature, and its holder as Jacket2, "© 2026 Jacket2", its Terms of Use unread and no license stated.

Jacket was founded in 1997 by John Tranter (1943–2023), an Australian poet, publisher and editor, as an internet quarterly, which he published and edited until 2010, when he gave it to the University of Pennsylvania.

Jacket2 maintains the complete archive of Jacket, forty issues from 1997 to 2010, and the encyclopedia calls it Jacket's "new incarnation", carrying the original "from a "2.0 mode" into an interactive magazine"; the census keeps the two apart, Jacket held as the archive Jacket2 keeps.
Its home page carries an interview with Tranter as Jacket's founder.
The year Jacket2 began is given differently by its sources.
